rationale: This is a positive case (capec min_records:1, attack min/max_records:10) requiring CAPEC-49/55/70/112/509/555/561/565 mapped to T1021, T1021.002, T1078.001, T1110, T1110.001, T1110.002, T1110.003, T1114.002, T1133, T1558.003, with mitigations M1018/M1021/M1026/M1027/M1030/M1032/M1035/M1036/M1037/M1041/M1042/M1047/M1051/M1060. The pipeline returned zero records and abstained entirely ('No records were returned by the routed specialists'). The root cause is visible in logic_flow: the executed Gremlin query filters `g.V().hasLabel("AttackPattern").has("id", within(ids))` where the resolved seed_ids were `["CWE-521"]—a Weakness id, not an AttackPattern id, so no AttackPattern vertex could ever match and the traversal was guaranteed to return 0 rows regardless of whether CAPEC-521 mappings exist in the graph. This is a retrieval/query-construction bug (wrong node type filtered by the seed id), not evidence that no CAPEC patterns exploit CWE-521. Because q1 produced no seed identifiers, q2 (ATT&CK mitigations) was skipped entirely as a dependency failure, so none of the 10 required T-numbers or 14 required mitigations were ever looked up. The answer surfaces 0 of the 32 required gold entities (8 CAPEC ids + 10 ATT&CK technique ids + 14 mitigation ids). No fabricated facts were stated (faithfulness/groundedness are vacuously satisfied since no claims were made), but the answer completely fails to answer the question, so correctness and completeness are both 0.
